basic.name: Arcane Flare
basic.description: Shoot a flare dealing 75~~0.04~~ damage to enemies hit, and an additional 105~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in the center. If a Hero is hit by the center, Soothing Mist's passive healing instantly activates.

basic.name: Polymorph
basic.description: Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Slowing their Movement Speed by 30% and Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.

basic.name: Pixie Dust
basic.description: Increase target Hero's Movement Speed by 20%, and grant them 30 Spell Armor for 3 seconds, reducing Spell damage taken by 30%.

heroic.name: Blink Heal
heroic.description:
Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200~~0.04~~.

Stores up to 2 charges.

heroic.name: Emerald Wind
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225~~0.04~~ damage and pushing enemies away.

heroic.name: Double Wyrmhole
heroic.description: Teleport to a nearby ally, healing them for 200~~0.04~~.

trait.name: Soothing Mist
trait.description:
Activate to remove all Stun, Root, Slow, and Silence effects from nearby allied Heroes.

Passive: Brightwing heals nearby allied Heroes for 110~~0.04~~ every 4 seconds

mount.name: Phase Shift
mount.description: After 2 seconds, teleport to an allied Hero and heal them for 25% of their maximum Health.

activable.name: Pixie Charm
activable.description:
Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured non-Elite Mercenary.

Passive: Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.

activable.name: Phase Out
activable.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

activable.name: Faerie Protector
activable.description:
Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.

Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

level1.name: Greater Polymorph
level1.description:
Passive: Increase Polymorph's range by 30%. 

If Brightwing hits an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center within 2 seconds of being Polymorphed, then reduce Polymorph's cooldown by 7 seconds and gain 50 Mana.

level1.name: Hyper Shift
level1.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level1.name: Pixie Charm
level1.description:
Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured non-Elite Mercenary.

Passive: Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.

level4.name: Dream Shot
level4.description: Increase Arcane Flare's range by 60%. Hitting a Hero with Arcane Flare's center reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.

level4.name: Unstable Anomaly
level4.description: Increase Polymorph's Slow by 15%. Upon expiration, Polymorph deals damage to nearby enemy Heroes equal to 2% of their maximum Health.

level4.name: Magic Spit
level4.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level7.name: Sticky Flare
level7.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by 20% for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to 40% if they are hit by the center portion.

level7.name: Peekaboo!
level7.description: Phase Shifting to an ally grants both Brightwing and her target a 335~~0.04~~ Shield for 4 seconds and reveals a large area around them for 5 seconds.

level7.name: Critical Mist
level7.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165~~0.04~~. Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level10.name: Blink Heal
level10.description:
Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200~~0.04~~.

Stores up to 2 charges.

level10.name: Emerald Wind
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225~~0.04~~ damage and pushing enemies away.

level13.name: Pixie Boost
level13.description: Increase Pixie Dust's Movement Speed bonus to 50%, decaying to 20% over 3 seconds.

level13.name: Safety Dust
level13.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level13.name: Pixie Power
level13.description: Reduce the cooldown of Pixie Dust by 3 seconds and increase the Spell Armor granted by 25.

level16.name: Hush!
level16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Critterize
level16.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level16.name: Phase Out
level16.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

level20.name: Invisible Friends
level20.description:
Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25~~0.04~~ health per second.

Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

level20.name: Intensive Winds
level20.description: Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.

level20.name: Speedy Dragon
level20.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.

level20.name: Faerie Protector
level20.description:
Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.

Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.
